image.prompt: Empty 1930s Shanghai shikumen bedroom, dark redwood canopy bed with translucent white gauze curtains, warm oil lamp on a small table, rain-streaked window reflecting cold red and green neon, dark rattan chair, no people
image.negativePrompt: people, human figures, characters, crowds, silhouettes, modern furniture, daylight, text, watermark, signature
image.sheet: Environment reference sheet on ONE 16:9 landscape canvas, panels separated by thin hairline rules. MAIN ZONE: the canonical wide view of the same empty 1930s Shanghai shikumen bedroom. RIGHT COLUMN: close-up studies of the redwood canopy bed and rain-streaked neon window. BOTTOM ROW: close-up studies of the warm oil lamp, dark rattan chair, aged plaster and wood materials. Every panel shows the SAME room with identical geometry and anchors. Absolutely no people anywhere. Semi-realistic environment concept art, painterly rendering with visible brush texture, grounded architectural perspective, cinematic depth. Weathered, lived-in materials and atmospheric depth.
